dedupe_keys.name: aquastat geo referenced database on dams

description: AQUASTAT's geo-referenced database on dams lists more than 14,000 dams worldwide, organised by region (Africa, Middle East, Central Asia, Southern and Eastern Asia, Europe, Oceania, Northern America, Central America and Caribbean, Southern America). For each dam FAO gathers location, height, reservoir capacity, surface area and main purpose during its country updates, to quantify water storage for agriculture and to estimate evaporation from reservoirs, which AQUASTAT reports as a national statistic; total dam capacities also feed the AQUASTAT core database. FAO notes that its data were an important input to the GRanD database, especially for African dams. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): FAO terms: statistical databases fall under the FAO Open Data Licensing Policy and Statistical Databases Terms of Use (licence of this database not named on the pages read). Coverage is global at point resolution, with collection dates varying by country. Caveats: FAO states the databases are neither complete nor error-free and reflect the best information at the time of each study; several regions lack notes or metadata. Simulation uses: system description of reservoirs and irrigation storage for water-resource and capacity-planning models, and exposure analyses downstream of dams. It complements the Global Map of Irrigation Areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas) and GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database).
